known_facts_book1: Mother of Peter, Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-tail; lives with them in a sand-bank under a big fir-tree.
Warns her children not to go into Mr. McGregor's garden, telling them their father had an accident there and was put in a pie by Mrs. McGregor.
Tells them to run along and not get into mischief, then goes out herself.
Takes a basket and an umbrella and walks through the wood to the baker's, buying a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.
Is busy cooking when Peter finally gets home, and wonders what he has done with his clothes.
Puts Peter to bed that evening and gives him a dose of camomile tea instead of supper.

known_relations_book1.Peter: Her son; warns him against the garden, then tends him after his ordeal.

known_facts_book1: One of the four little Rabbits, named first among the siblings at the start of the book.
One of the 'good little bunnies' who goes down the lane with Mopsy and Cotton-tail to gather blackberries, instead of raiding Mr. McGregor's garden.
Has bread, milk and blackberries for supper, while Peter is given camomile tea instead.
